training_note: Phase-1 checkpoint (classifier head only, backbone frozen). The run was interrupted at epoch 5 of 10 before fine-tuning, so this is the best frozen-backbone checkpoint rather than a completed two-phase model.

dataset.negatives: corn, PlantVillage, tomato, potato, chilli, soil
dataset.negative_note: Maize is the hardest negative: its leaves share the long blade shape and green of sugarcane, so it is deliberately the largest negative source.

honesty_note: This model answers one question only: does this photograph show sugarcane. It does not diagnose disease and says nothing about plant health.

holdout_evaluation.note: Held out before training. Maize is reported separately because it is the hard case: 7.2 % of maize photographs are still accepted as sugarcane. Both sets come from the same source datasets, so same-source style cues cannot be ruled out; the maize figure is the one to trust least optimistically.
